Technical Name                                 CreditWorthinessChangelnformation_In
Namespace                                        http://sap.com/xi/FICA/Global m%,
Application Component                         FI-CA

Web Service Definition (Back End)           FKK_CREDITWORTHINESSCHGIN
Category                                            SAP A2A

Direction                                            inbound

Mode                                                asynchronous

Idempotency                                       not applicable

Change/Update Behavior                      Typel

P2P Communication Enabled                  yes

Business Context and Use

The system displays the previous and new values to show you exactly how the debtor’s credit worthiness rating has changed.

Related Operations

e This inbound service operation has a corrsponding outbound service operation Inform of Credit Worthiness Change for the
integration with the SAP Credit Management process component.

Features

The Change Contract Account based Credit Worthiness Change Infomation inbound operation receives information from the
SAP Credit Management component. This is sent when a debtor’s creditworthiness rating changes. This helps you to ensure that
your creditworthiness information is as up to date as possible

The services operation receives the following data:

e Rating

e Credit limit

e Risk class

e Blocking indicator and its reason code

e Result of a performed credit check

Error Handling

Forward Error Handling

The Change Contract Account based Credit Worthiness Change Infomation inbound operation supports Forward Error Handling
(FEH). The following error categories are used:
